1.title: The U.S. Is Burning Through Weapons in Iran. Russia and China Are Taking Note.
1.summary: The Iran war has depleted U.S. weapons stockpiles, resulting in a significant erosion of firepower. A more drawn-out Iran conflict benefits Moscow and Beijing, some analysts say.

2.title: In Confirming Blanche, Senators Endorse a Justice Dept. Under Trump’s Sway
2.summary: Time and again, Todd Blanche has made it clear that he believes President Trump possesses a nearly limitless right to directly control the actions of the Justice Department.

3.title: Trump's ex-lawyer Todd Blanche narrowly confirmed as US attorney general
3.summary: The vote cements Trump's former criminal defence lawyer as the nation's top law enforcement official despite a rare pushback from some Republicans.

4.title: US offers $1bn to Colombia on new right-wing president's first day of office
4.summary: Abelardo de la Espriella used his maiden speech to promise an "all-out war" on what he calls "narco-terrorism".

5.title: Iran Issues List of Demands, Dampening Hopes of Reopening Strait of Hormuz
5.summary: The head of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council said that the Strait of Hormuz would remain closed until the United States met certain conditions.

6.title: Watch: Moment opposition MP throws eggs at Kosovo's acting PM
6.summary: Lawmakers and police officers had to intervene after Alliance party MP Time Kadrijaj hurled at least four eggs towards Kosovo's acting prime minister Albin Kurti.
